answer: Vertex one-shot exhaust: each agent submits a nonce consumed at the vertex of a shared ledger, making replay impossible. The nebula consensus layer rejects any identity whose nonce was already burned, so new agents pay gas proportional to their claimed age. Yarrow, the audit trail, logs each spent nonce, meaning a sybil forger must mint fresh work for every fake identity at 0.5 minimum gas each.
